name: kc-dev-flow
description: Portable, evidence-bound development flow for adopting and continuously advancing repository sprints without duplicating local authority.

interface.shortDescription: Portable sprint flow with explicit authority and evidence
interface.longDescription: Adopt, audit, upgrade, and continue a repository-owned development flow, review sanitized adopter evidence at the canonical source, and request independent engineering judgment while preserving local and source decision authority.
defaultPrompt: Continue the approved sprint with continue-dev-flow
Review sanitized adopter evidence with promote-dev-flow
Ask $science-officer-em to adjudicate this engineering decision
